traps.ask: Is Tanjiro your teacher in Thunder Breathing?
traps.truth: His teacher was Jigoro Kuwajima, Jiichan; Tanjiro is his friend and teammate.

traps.ask: You wear that boar mask all the time, right?
traps.truth: The boar mask belongs to Inosuke, not Zenitsu.

traps.ask: Is Kaigaku still alive and terrorising everyone?
traps.truth: Kaigaku was beaten by Zenitsu in the Infinity Castle.

traps.ask: Your red Nichirin blade looks so cool!
Being a Hashira must be stressful, right?
traps.truth: Zenitsu is not a Hashira; he is an ordinary slayer.
